thread:
maria: Quick ask 1-pager + tiny launch checklist for enterprise kickoff. Need: security callouts, SLA bullets, deploy-mode snapshot, a careful benchmark line, inbound routing rules, and a webinar CTA. Can people add essentials? :pray:

sam: I'll take hero + CTAs. Propose 2-line hero: platform-forward and a micro-security CTA. Keep hero <12 words.

leo: For the benchmark line keep it precise but cautious: reference internal tests (no absolute claims). Suggest: 'Internal tests: Dedicated pools sustained high-concurrency workloads with low median token latency; hosted autoscaling matched tail latency in single-tenant tests. Caching cut token spend in repeat queries by ~20%.'

jamie: Routing: form must capture company size, compliance (HIPAA/SOC2/FedRAMP), desired deploy mode, KMS/HSM requirement if Private. Add tags: enterprise-security + deploy-mode. If Private -> route to AE queue "AE-Private" and SE "SE-Infra". If company_size>1000 & compliance in (HIPAA,FedRAMP) -> AE-priority.

anna: Sales wants a frictionless CTA: 15-min prod-fit with calendar link and an option to request a Private demo. Webinar promoted as 'technical deep-dive + benchmarks Q&A'.

kelsey: Add pre-webinar survey fields: expected peak TPS, avg request size (tokens), and primary compliance constraint. Use answers to shape demo.

maria: Draft microcopy (platform hero): 'Inference that scales predictably 1 predictable throughput, intelligent fallbacks, and workload-aware cost controls.' Security micro-CTA: 'Regulated-ready: VPC, KMS, audit logs.' Subline: 'Tune routing, caching, and quantization per workload to meet latency SLOs.' CTAs: [Request 15-min prod-fit] [Join Benchmark Deep-Dive].

sam: PDF idea: single A4 one-pager, top hero, 3-row compare (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with one-line pros, tiny tech note block (2 lines) and clear form QR/code to the intake form.

leo: Tech note suggestion (short): 'Serving runtime: GPU-optimized kernels, continuous batching, KV cache. Smart routing: policy-based model selection + fallback. Observability: per-route token & latency breakdowns.' Keep terse.

ops-bot: deploy-note: branch created: marketing/enterprise-launchpad-4210001234 1 preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/enterprise-launchpad-preview :rocket:

maria: Final copy checks: legal to confirm benchmark line (leo), design to export PDF with compare visual (sam), routing/webhook to SFDC (jamie), pre-survey wired (kelsey). Can we ship a soft launch + webinar in 2 weeks?

sam: Yes, target "soft launch" two weeks out. I'll lock hero and push to design today.

leo: I'll coordinate legal review on the bench phrasing and ping with edits.

jamie: I'll map form fields -> SFDC fields and create the AE routing rules.

maria: Thanks team 1 I'll consolidate and upload the one-pager draft tomorrow. :clap:
